video.handling_after_case_end: After each displayed interval, hold its last selected frame in grayscale with the interval end time and STILL label. This is display-only, not additional motion or measured hold time; no loop or interpolation.
video.comparison_excerpt_scope: Locomotion: complete 12-second recordings. Prone/wave/sit: first complete action cycle only (12/18/16 seconds). PASS/NOT MET remains the full 12/24/36/32-second evaluation result; individual originals are unchanged.

limitations: Four separately trained action-mean policies, not one unified9skill actor.
No continuous transition between motions, disturbance sweep, sensor-noise or hardware validation.
First terminal remains visible; the terminal rendered image may follow an automatic reset.

Original walking videos retain their initial camera frame. The first complete robot view is frame1 for forward, backward, left, right and turn_left, and frame0 for turn_right; no leading frames were trimmed.
h is a simulated limiter load-budget state, not measured temperature.

publication_scope: Selected self-produced numeric summaries, authored explanations and explicitly selected final simulation media. Hardware photographs and derivatives, identifiers, private paths, CAD/meshes, weights, raw traces and logs are excluded.
